questions.text: Before becoming Iron Man, Tony Stark graduated from which elite real-world institute at age 17?
questions.hint: Located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, where engineering geeks build robots while dropping calculators.

questions.text: What is the alias adopted by Bucky Barnes after being brainwashed by Soviet intelligence with a cybernetic arm?
questions.hint: Think the coldest season of the calendar plus armed military personnel.

questions.text: Which mutant superhero's secondary mutation allowed him to transform into a beast with blue fur and feline features?
questions.hint: He's a literate, Shakespeare-quoting gentleman who literally looks like a giant blue gorilla-cat.

questions.text: In the MCU, what is the full name of the artificial intelligence that preceded FRIDAY in Tony Stark's suits?
questions.answer: J.A.R.V.I.S. (Just A Rather Very Intelligent System)
questions.hint: Named after Howard Stark's loyal butler, but upgraded with millions of silicon transistors.

questions.text: What cosmic artifact gives the Nova Corps their power and is stored in the Worldmind?
questions.hint: Supernova minus the 'super'—it powers human rockets across the galaxy.

questions.text: What is the real civilian surname of Norman Osborn's alter ego, Spider-Man's greatest nemesis?
questions.hint: He rides a glider tossing explosive pumpkin spice lattes while laughing hysterically.

questions.text: Which mutant clone of Wolverine, created by the Facility, later assumed the mantle of the All-New Wolverine?
questions.hint: Named after a Roman numeral for 10 plus 13—her foot claws make pedicures impossible.

questions.text: In the 'Days of Future Past' timeline, what mutant-hunting robotic autonomous entities govern North America?
questions.hint: Towering purple robotic watchmen whose single job is scanning for X-genes and getting demolished by Wolverine.

questions.text: What ancient mutant known as En Sabah Nur believes strictly in the doctrine of 'survival of the fittest'?
questions.hint: Ancient Egyptian mutant who thinks four horsemen are the ultimate eco-friendly method of public transit.

questions.text: Doctor Octopus founded which collective of six supervillains to defeat Spider-Man?
questions.hint: Doc Ock realized five villains wasn't enough to squash an arachnid, so he rounded up half a dozen.

questions.text: Which comic book writer wrote the legendary 'Demon in a Bottle' arc addressing Tony Stark's alcoholism in 1979?
questions.hint: A storyline so poignant it proved even Iron Man's golden titanium suit can't deflect liver damage.

questions.text: What four-word catchphrase was famously used by Stan Lee as his sign-off in monthly Marvel Bullpen Bulletins?
questions.hint: Latin for 'ever upward'—Stan's unmistakable one-word catchphrase of pure optimism!

questions.text: In 1992, seven top artists left Marvel to form what competitor publisher responsible for Spawn and Savage Dragon?
questions.hint: They wanted artistic freedom, so they created an 'Image' of their own.

questions.text: Which British writer penned the transformative 1980s run of Thor, introducing Beta Ray Bill?
questions.hint: He gave Thor a horse-faced alien brother and once turned the Odinson into an amphibian (Throg)!

questions.text: Which Marvel imprint, started in 2000, updated classic characters for contemporary audiences without 40 years of continuity baggage?
questions.hint: Earth-1610, where Spider-Man was a millennial kid again and Nick Fury was modeled after Samuel L. Jackson.

questions.text: In Avengers: Infinity War, on which barren planet does Thanos sacrifice Gamora to acquire the Soul Stone?
questions.hint: A steep cliff, a floating Red Skull concierge, and a heartbreaking fall for a green daughter.

questions.text: What song by Blue Swede plays during the opening sequence of Guardians of the Galaxy (2014)?
questions.hint: Ooga-chaka ooga-ooga ooga-chaka! You're definitely trapped in a vibe.

questions.text: Who directed both Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and animated segments of Spider-Man lore?
questions.answer: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
questions.hint: A trio of visionary animators whose 12-fps comic-book framerate won an Academy Award.

questions.text: Which actor portrayed Doctor Doom in the 2005 and 2007 Fantastic Four movies directed by Tim Story?
questions.hint: Nip/Tuck star who donned the Latverian mask decades before Robert Downey Jr. was recruited for Doomsday.

questions.text: What MCU series introduced the Time Variance Authority (TVA) and the concept of Sacred Timeline pruning?
questions.hint: The God of Mischief finally discovered 'glorious purpose' holding the multiverse together like a green tree.

questions.text: In 1996's DC versus Marvel crossover event, who won the fan-voted battle between Batman and Captain America?
questions.hint: Because comic nerds firmly believe enough prep time and smoke pellets beats super soldier serum every single time.

questions.text: What fast-talking merc with a mouth is famous for consistently breaking the fourth wall and speaking directly to the reader?
questions.hint: He loves chimichangas, wears red so bad guys can't see him bleed, and knows he's inside this quiz right now.

questions.text: Which 16-bit arcade brawler released by Konami in 1992 allowed up to six simultaneous players across two screens to fight Magneto's army?
questions.hint: 'Welcome to die!' shouted Magneto as six kids furiously mashed quarter-munching joystick buttons.

questions.text: Which herald of Galactus was once the astronomer Frankie Raye, possessing pyrokinetic abilities?
questions.hint: Shares an alias with a cosmic corpsman, but with fiery human-torch flair.

questions.text: TIEBREAKER / FINAL: Doctor Doom was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby, debuting in which milestone 1962 comic issue?
questions.hint: His high-tech time platform and green cloak first appeared in issue #5 of Marvel's first superhero family.
